caseNameFull: McGoldrick, Comptroller of the City of New York v. Gulf Oil Corporation
attorneys: Messrs. William C. Chanler, Pax-ton Blair, Sol Charles Levine, and-Jerome R. Hellerstein for petitioner. Mr. Matthew S. Gibson for respondent. By special leave of Court, Messrs. George deForest Lord and Woodson D. Scott filed a brief on behalf of the Cunard White Star Ltd., as amicus curiae, opposing the petition.

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the Supreme Court of New York granted.
